title: cymopterus newberryi
intro: Cymopterus newberryi, commonly known as Newberry's spring centaury or Newberry's spring centaury, is a species of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymopterus newberryi include soothing coughs, relieving congestion, and reducing fever, making it a valuable medicinal herb. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
